decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 23 May 2005 the single storey detached building, for use as a gym/fitness and storage room, measuring 9.425 metres long, 6.6 metres wide and 3.946 metres high to top of ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 
Condition : 2 - Informative: The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used 	for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 5 Taunton Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey detached building for use as a gym/fitness and storage room to rear of garden of house.
